---
title: Crostini with Buffalo Mozzarella

time_min: 23
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 350 g of buffalo mozzarella
- 80 g of cherry tomatoes
- 8 anchovy fillets in oil
- 8 slices of country bread
- 6 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste fresh oregano
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Cut the bread slices in half and brush them with a little oil.
2. Chop the anchovies.
3. Slice the mozzarella and arrange it on the bread slices with the chopped anchovies.
4. Wash the cherry tomatoes, cut them into wedges and let them drain.
5. Place the cherry tomatoes on the mozzarella slices and sprinkle with a little oregano.
6. Place the bread slices on the baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and season them with oil and a pinch of salt.
7. Melt the mozzarella in the oven at 200 °C for about 5-8 minutes.
